current_answer: Seven official pages explicitly invite ambassador applications without a published passed deadline: Hedera, Cyfrin, Soneium, Aster, Elk, Nomis and Torium. Soneium’s official announcement says applications are open and links a hosted form; the form did not expose its fields or acceptance state. Torium says applications are open and publishes a seven-day public-content track and conditional view-linked USDT rewards, but no independent payout report was checked. Nexo’s previously tracked ambassador URL now redirects to its general site, so it is no longer a confirmed route. Bitget’s Trading Builder recruitment remains open through 30 Sep 2026 for experienced trading-community operators; MetaMask is not confirmed, Solana and SideShift are closed, and PIVX is referral-only.

catalogue_card.question: Soneium says apply now; Nexo’s old route vanished
catalogue_card.text: Soneium moves into the live table after its official page explicitly opened applications. Nexo leaves it because the saved ambassador link now redirects away. Torium is open, but its payment claims have no independent check.

summary: Soneium’s official page explicitly says it is opening an ambassador program and links a hosted application route; cash terms are not stated.
Torium publishes an open route, a seven-day initiation track and conditional USDT reward thresholds. Its terms leave rewards to review, and no independent payout report was found.
Nexo’s old ambassador URL now redirects to the general Nexo site, so previous role and salary language is not a current public opportunity.
Hedera, Cyfrin, Elk and Nomis still show official routes; Aster remains listed from its 14 Sep check.
Bitget’s distinct Trading Builder recruitment ends 30 Sep 2026; MetaMask is still not a confirmed public route, Solana and SideShift are closed, and PIVX is referral-only.
uncertainty: An official page that says applications are open does not prove a hosted form will accept a submission or that an applicant will be selected.
Most open routes do not publish decision-ready cash terms, hours or full selection rules.
Soneium’s hosted form did not expose data fields or a submission-state message in this check.
Torium’s reward and payout statements are issuer claims; no independent payment report was checked.
Nexo may publish a new or private route elsewhere; the saved public ambassador URL is no longer one.
freshness_note: Status reflects the last substantive check shown in each row. Hedera, Cyfrin, Soneium, Elk, Nomis, Torium, Bitget, Solana and SideShift were checked on 15 Sep 2026; Aster was last substantively checked on 14 Sep 2026. Recheck each route before sharing data, promoting trading products or committing recurring work.
